structured_result.problem_understood: The sandbox requires machine-readable synthetic inputs to validate the conformance client schema preflight and loopback submission without relying on private core validation algorithms or real-world state.

request_body.selection_rationale: A TEST_VECTOR directly satisfies the AN-04 expected outputs of a synthetic object and validation result by defining bounded inputs, expected conformance passes, and explicit failure behaviors for malformed payloads.

decision_criteria: No Authority or adoption claim is created.
The customer-visible Conformance result is interpreted.
limitations: Requires ephemeral sandbox key for loopback execution
Does not validate private core algorithms
Conformance pass does not imply standard adoption
